instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope feels handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture (soft matte, subtle fibers, subtle pearlescent accents), elegant folds and precise geometry. The wax seal on the envelope must explicitly feature two intertwined wedding rings engraved on it, finely detailed and tactile, with an elegant ribbon and ornamental closure enhancing the premium wedding aesthetic. The envelope is placed within a rich, story-driven tropical environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a narrative scene — a lush tropical garden with dense dark moss-green foliage, exotic leaves, palm fronds, vivid magenta and pink flowers, vibrant orange blossoms, and soft light salmon petals — softly blurred but visually recognizable. Botanical elements create depth and context while keeping the envelope as the clear hero. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including tropical flowers, petals, delicate butterflies, glowing dust, and floating light particles, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements feel natural, gently drifting, enhancing motion and warmth without overpowering the composition. Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and subtle volumetric light rays filtering through the tropical foliage. Atmospheric haze, soft mist, and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, elegant, premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, inspired by luxury invitations and tropical editorial photography — dark moss green, magenta, pink, vibrant orange, and light salmon tones — with smooth gradients, luminous highlights, and controlled contrast. Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic tropical realism, elegant, luxurious, magical, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, visually enchanting, suitable for premium tropical wedding invitations and storytelling visuals.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a large blank sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame, with strong central presence and clear dominance in the scene. The sheet feels premium, refined and tactile, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers, clean edges and elegant natural curvature. It remains completely blank, serving as the hero canvas of the composition, while still leaving visible space around its borders to reveal the ground plane, background context and side elements.

The paper is surrounded by rich tropical ornamental elements arranged organically around it, framing the composition without overpowering the blank surface. Lush dark moss-green foliage, exotic leaves, palm fronds, tropical flowers, magenta blossoms, pink petals, vibrant orange accents and soft salmon-toned floral details create a layered decorative border. These elements feel natural, fresh and luxurious, with a mix of dense botanical textures and airy floating petals, subtly curving around the sheet to enhance depth and visual rhythm.

The environment is a tropical story-driven setting, not a flat backdrop. The background softly reveals a warm and atmospheric tropical scene with hints of lush vegetation, sunlit humidity, distant natural textures and subtle environmental depth, while remaining softly blurred so the blank sheet stays as the clear focal point. The ground is partially visible beneath the paper, adding realism and spatial grounding, with a natural surface such as stone, wood or earth-toned terrain that supports the composition. Side elements extend into the frame to create balance and enclosure.

Lighting is cinematic, soft and dramatic, with a warm tropical glow illuminating the paper and surrounding botanicals. Gentle key light highlights the paper’s texture, delicate rim light defines its silhouette, and subtle volumetric light filters through foliage, creating a dreamy, premium atmosphere. Soft shadows, atmospheric haze and faint floating particles enhance the sense of humidity, freshness and natural elegance. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, dominated by dark moss green, magenta, pink, vibrant orange and light salmon, with smooth gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast.

Composition: foreground-dominant, blank sheet sharply in focus, occupying nearly the full frame while preserving visible ground, background and side ornamentation, strong sense of depth and layered tropical framing. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper surface and botanical details, cinematic bokeh in the background. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic tropical realism, elegant, lush, premium editorial composition. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, visually rich, luxurious, suitable for tropical-themed design presentations and premium decorative visuals.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Tropical) e na paleta de cores (Verde musgo escuro, magenta, rosa pink, laranja vibrante e salmão claro). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "Casamento Mirian e Marcos". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Copie ambas literalmente, sem acrescentar idade, data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
